description: Mixed emergence corpus: 3 identical chains (staging-promotion path), 2 noisy chains (normalisation isolation), 1 partial chain against a pre-seeded canonical pattern (ghost source). Curated for the test-harden skill's L3 graduation cycle on Phase 6.

assertions.because: Group A's 3 identical chains meet the staging threshold of 3 — emerges as at least one new staging template
Group C's pre-seeded canonical pattern survives detection (lifecycle is monotonic without demotion triggers in this fixture)

Differing entity_type at pos 0 (standard_rule vs api_function) must produce distinct normalised templates — Group B's edges either get no pattern_id (below threshold of 3) or a different pattern_id from Group A's cluster
Entity at pos 0 of partial chain covers N-1 of the 3-position canonical pattern → at least one missing position surfaces as a ghost

detect_duration_ms.because: Spec 17:733 budget; this fixture has 5 chains so should be well under cap. Note: full <2s @ 1000 chains is tracked under nmemo-oex.

match_per_edge_ms.because: Spec 17:744 budget (verified in G8 inline benchmark).

graduation_notes: When this corpus exercises clean — identical chains cluster, noisy chains stay isolated, ghosts surface — the test-harden skill can mutate fixture contents (predicate substitutions, entity_type swaps, edge-strength jitter) without rewriting the test plan. Quality bar for graduation: identical chains always cluster to one template; noisy chains never collide; ghost detection precision (correct missing positions surfaced) stays ≥80% across mutated variants.
